title: Leibniz rule for a componentwise C^1 family of bilinear forms along a C^1 map
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, L := L(R^n, R^l), U an open subset of R^n, a : R^n -> (continuous bilinear forms on L), i.e. a(x) ∈ L(L, L(L, R)), such that x ↦ a(x)[P][Q] is C^1 on U for all P, Q ∈ L, w : R^n -> L of class C^1 on U, and e ∈ R^n. Then the L*-valued map x ↦ a(x)[w(x)] is C^1 on U, and for every x ∈ U and P ∈ L: (D(a(·)[w(·)])(x) e)[P] = a(x)[Dw(x) e][P] + D(a(·)[w(x)][P])(x) e, where w(x) is frozen in the last term.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (w : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (e : Rn n), IsOpen U → (∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => a x P Q) U) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => a x (w x)) U ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, fderiv ℝ (fun z => a z (w z)) x e P = a x (fderiv ℝ w x e) P + fderiv ℝ (fun z => a z (w x) P) x e
